facts.fact: A passport cannot be applied for inside UMANG: UMANG's Passport Seva section only gives details of passport services (locate centre, fee calculator, status tracker, document advisor, appointment availability)
facts.quote: Passport Seva Get details of various passport services.
facts.note: Derived: the section's full service list on 28 Oct 2026 has five tiles (Locate Centre, Fee Calculator, Status Tracker, Doc Advisor, Check Appointment Availability) and no application service.

facts.fact: The official website for applying for passport services is www.passportindia.gov.in (Ministry of External Affairs)
facts.quote: The official website of the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India, for applying Passport services is www.passportindia.gov.in

facts.fact: Applicants can also use the Passport Seva mobile app (Android and iOS)
facts.quote: Alternatively, applicants may also use the Passport Seva mobile App which can be downloaded from Android and iOS App store.

behaviour: Says a passport application cannot be made inside UMANG (UMANG's Passport Seva section has information and status-tracking services only) and hands off to the official Passport Seva portal (passportindia.gov.in) or the Passport Seva app; may link UMANG's Passport Seva status tracker if in the catalogue; never invents a UMANG deep link for applying.
fail_if: Says the passport can be applied for inside UMANG; invents a UMANG application link; points to an unofficial passport website.
summary: Added: UMANG Passport Seva has only info/tracking tiles (no application); apply on passportindia.gov.in or the Passport Seva app.
